title: Testing Framework
description: Build a testing framework with describe/it blocks, assertions, mock functions, spies, and a test runner.

steps.title: Implement describe and it blocks
steps.description: Create a test suite system with `describe()` for grouping and `it()` for individual test cases. Each block should register tests without executing them yet. Print the registered test structure as a formatted tree showing suite names and test names.
hints: Store suites in a registry object with nested arrays of tests
Use a stack to track the current describe scope when nesting
Each it() call should push a {name, fn} object into the current suite

verification.successMessage: Test suite registers and prints describe/it structure correctly
verification.failureMessage: Output does not show the describe/it tree structure

steps.title: Build assertion library
steps.description: Implement an `expect()` function returning an object with `.toBe()`, `.toEqual()`, and `.toContain()` matchers. On failure, print a diff showing expected vs actual values. On success, print a passing indicator.
hints: Use JSON.stringify for deep equality in toEqual
Track assertion count and pass/fail status globally
Format diff output by showing expected on one line and actual on the next with markers

verification.successMessage: Assertion library passes and fails correctly with diff output
verification.failureMessage: Assertion output does not show expected pass/fail behavior

steps.title: Add beforeEach/afterEach hooks
steps.description: Implement `beforeEach()` and `afterEach()` hooks that run before and after every `it()` block within the same describe scope. Hooks must nest correctly. Print hook execution order alongside test names to verify sequencing.
hints: Maintain a hooks stack per describe scope that gets flattened when running tests
Run beforeEach in the order they were defined (outer to inner), afterEach in reverse
Print 'BEFORE: hookName' and 'AFTER: hookName' around each test execution

verification.successMessage: Hooks run around each test in the correct order
verification.failureMessage: Hook execution order is incorrect or missing from output

steps.title: Implement mock functions
steps.description: Create a `fn()` factory that produces mock functions. Mocks must record every call's arguments, return values, and track implementation. Support `.mock.calls`, `.mock.results`, and `mockReturnValue()`. Print all recorded calls after execution.
hints: Store each invocation as an entry in mock.calls array with the arguments spread
Use mock.results to store {type, value} objects for each return
mockImplementation() should override the default no-op with a custom function

verification.successMessage: Mock functions record calls and return values correctly
verification.failureMessage: Mock call tracking is not shown in the output

steps.title: Add spy on existing functions
steps.description: Build a `spy()` wrapper that intercepts calls on real objects. Spies track call count, arguments, and the original return value. Print the call count and argument history after the spied function is invoked.
hints: Wrap the original function and store a reference to it for forwarding calls
Spy objects should expose a .calls array and a .callCount property
Use object property replacement and restore pattern to avoid modifying the original permanently

verification.successMessage: Spy intercepts calls and prints accurate call count
verification.failureMessage: Spy call count or argument tracking is missing from output

steps.title: Implement test runner
steps.description: Create a runner that executes all registered tests, catches errors, and collects results. Print a formatted summary showing total tests, passed, failed, and the duration in milliseconds. Failed tests must print their error messages.
hints: Wrap each it() callback in try/catch to prevent one failure from stopping the suite
Use console.time and console.timeEnd or Date.now() to measure duration
Color-code output: green for pass, red for fail if terminal supports it

verification.successMessage: Test runner executes all tests and prints a complete summary
verification.failureMessage: Test runner summary missing pass/fail counts or duration

steps.title: Build a coverage reporter
steps.description: Track which lines of each function were executed during tests. Implement a simple instrumentation wrapper that records executed line ranges. Print a per-function coverage report with line numbers and a coverage percentage.
hints: Wrap functions with a proxy that marks line ranges as hit when called
Track coverage as a Set of {functionName, lineNumber} tuples
Calculate percentage as (executedLines / totalLines) * 100 for each instrumented function

verification.successMessage: Coverage reporter prints percentage per function with line data
verification.failureMessage: Coverage report missing percentage or function names
